technology_name: Affordable Advanced Wound Care Using Herbal-Based Nanopad
institution: KSCSTE- Jawaharlal Nehru Tropical Botanic Garden & Research Institute (JNTBGRI)
problem_solved: High cost of advanced wound care products and the need for comprehensive multi-stage therapeutic intervention to accelerate delayed healing and prevent infections.
description: A multi-functional nanofibre wound healing pad developed using a layer-by-layer construction strategy, where each layer executes a targeted therapeutic function. The core layer incorporates "Coded Compound X", a bioactive molecule isolated from "Coded Plant Y" via activity-guided isolation. Preclinical evaluations in rat models demonstrated superior wound repair metrics compared to standard reference drugs. The multi-layered design acts synergistically to provide antimicrobial protection, optimal moisture retention, and accelerated tissue regeneration.
applications:
• Advanced clinical wound dressings for chronic ulcers and burn management

• Mass-market first-aid, surgical, and emergency trauma care kits

• Manufacturing of specialized herbal-bioactive medical textiles

• Indigenous low-cost supply chains for rural and resource-limited healthcare sectors
